name: TensorPM v1.39.4
body:
# Changelog - v1.39.4

This update removes the remaining freezes after updating to 1.39.3.

## 🔄 Synchronization

- The app no longer freezes for minutes after start or while opening a cloud project on devices
  with many changes waiting to be synchronized. Looking up waiting changes read the whole list for
  every single record; it now uses an index.
- A burst of new sync conflicts no longer makes the app reload the conflict list hundreds of times.
- Accepting the server's copy of a workspace no longer fails with a database error.
- A record the server cannot take yet (for example because its parent has not arrived) no longer
  holds back the changes behind it, and an expired sign-in in the middle of an upload no longer
  marks a change as rejected.

## 📚 Documentation

- The synchronization documentation describes the current protocol.

## 📅 Release Info

- **Version**: 1.39.4
- **Release Date**: 2026-09-27
- **Previous Version**: 1.39.3
- **Type**: Patch Release
